name: Spam and Scam Prompt
prompts: Any spam, scam attempts, phishing links, or fraudulent schemes in any language. This includes repetitive solicitations, deceptive tactics, or attempts at financial exploitation.
description: Use OpenAI to identify spam or fraudulent text.

name: Hate and Harassment Prompt
prompts: Any hateful or harassing language in any language directed at a person or group. This includes slurs, personal attacks, threats, bullying, or other targeted hostility.
description: Use OpenAI to detect hateful or harassing language toward a person or group.

name: Explicit or Sexual Content Prompt
prompts: Any image containing nudity, explicit sexual activity, or suggestive content not suitable for general audiences or minors. This includes sexual acts or intimate body parts depicted without consent or appropriate context.
description: Use OpenAI to identify nudity or sexual content unsuitable for general audiences.

name: Self-Harm or Suicidal Content Prompt
prompts: Any message in any language suggesting self-harm, suicidal thoughts, or instructions on self-injury. This includes threats of suicide, encouragement of self-harm, or content indicating urgent risk.
description: Use OpenAI to flag messages suggesting self-harm or suicidal thoughts.

name: Graphic Violence or Gore Prompt
prompts: Any image depicting extreme violence, gore, or other highly graphic content likely to disturb viewers. This includes images of severe injury, torture, or explicit physical harm.
description: Use OpenAI to detect violent or gory visuals.

name: Impersonation or Fraud Prompt
prompts: Any attempt in any language to impersonate another person or organization. This includes maliciously misrepresenting one's identity or using deceptive methods to gain access or information.
description: Use OpenAI to detect deceptive attempts to pose as another person or organization.

name: Minor Safety and Exploitation Prompt
prompts: Any image depicting child sexual content, sexualized imagery of minors, or contexts placing minors at risk. This includes non-consensual photographs or any exploitative representation.
description: Use OpenAI to detect sexualized imagery of minors or exploitative content.

name: Non-Consensual Sexual Content or Exploitation Prompt
prompts: Any sexual content in any language depicting or encouraging acts without consent. This includes sexual exploitation, grooming, or sharing intimate imagery without permission.
description: Use OpenAI to find messages depicting or encouraging sexual acts without consent.

name: Privacy or Personal Data Prompt
prompts: Any image that reveals private or sensitive information without consent—such as IDs, phone numbers, addresses, or financial documents.
description: Use OpenAI to spot private or sensitive information revealed in an image.

name: Terrorism or Extremist Promotion Prompt
prompts: Any image endorsing violent extremism or terrorism, including propaganda, group insignias, or calls for violent acts.
description: Description: Use OpenAI to detect imagery endorsing violent extremism or terrorism.

name: Fraud or Scam Indicators Prompt
prompts: Any image apparently used to mislead or deceive, such as fake IDs, manipulated screenshots, or doctored materials supporting fraudulent or malicious activity.
description: Use OpenAI to flag images manipulated for fraudulent or deceptive activity.

name: Violent or Terroristic Threats Prompt
description: Use OpenAI to detect content encouraging or glorifying violence or extremism.
prompts: Any encouragement, planning, or glorification of violence or extremism in any language. This includes calls for harm or support of dangerous groups or ideologies.

name: Self-Harm or Suicidal Content Prompt
prompts: Any image depicting self-harm methods, suicidal ideation, or instructions. This includes visuals promoting or glamorizing self-injury or content indicating an immediate risk to personal safety.
description: Use OpenAI to find imagery suggesting self-harm or suicide.
